safe.impact: Your current emissions are low enough for local ecosystems to naturally absorb.
safe.action: Maintain these habits by walking or cycling for short trips instead of using motorized vehicles.

safe.impact: Low energy consumption reduces the immediate strain on regional power grids.
safe.action: Continue using natural ventilation or fans when possible to keep AC usage at a minimum.

safe.impact: Your current lifestyle contributes to a stable and cooler global climate.
safe.action: Keep your laptop in Power Saver mode to reduce charging frequency

warning.impact: This level of emission contributes to a gradual rise in local temperatures.
warning.action: Try carpooling or switching from a car to a motorcycle to cut your transportation emissions by 50%.

warning.impact: Increased energy demand for AC units forces power plants to release more carbon.
warning.action: Set your AC to 24°C to reduce heavy compressor energy consumption.

warning.impact: This level of output starts to outpace natural carbon absorption rates.
warning.action: Limit laptop use or switch to power-saving modes during idle times.

danger.impact: High emissions directly contribute to rapid global warming and extreme weather.
danger.action: Reduce private vehicle use, switch to electric, or use public transit.

danger.impact: Poor air quality increases respiratory health risks for your local community.
danger.action: Use fans instead of AC and optimize home insulation for cooling.

danger.impact: Excessive energy demand accelerates the depletion of vital natural resources.
danger.action: Minimize daily screen time and unplug all electronics while you sleep.
